title: 21.9 A 20MHz & 1MHz Dual-Loop Non-Uniform-Multi-Inductor Hybrid DC-DC Converter with Specified Inductor Current Allocation and Fast Transient Response
problem: Series-capacitor buck (SCB) hybrid converters offer efficiency but suffer from slow load transient response due to low loop bandwidth (1/10–1/5 of switching frequency) and inability to rapidly increase inductor current slew rate during transients. Multiple inductors cannot simultaneously activate; load step-down slew rate limited by low V_out and large inductance.
motivation: Consumer/automotive/industrial power delivery demands fast transient response to load steps while maintaining high efficiency; low loop bandwidth fundamentally constrains inductor slew rate, degrading voltage regulation speed.
method: The converter uses two feedback loops running at different speeds (20 MHz and 1 MHz) to rapidly detect and respond to sudden changes in power demand. Instead of one large inductor, it uses multiple inductors of different sizes that can all be activated at the same time, with a current allocation strategy that decides how much current should flow through each one. By controlling when each inductor's switches turn on and off, the system can quickly increase current levels, responding to power demand changes while maintaining the efficiency benefits of series-capacitor buck converters.
key_novelty: This converter enables simultaneous activation of multiple inductors of different sizes using dual-speed feedback control (20 MHz and 1 MHz) with intelligent current allocation, achieving 2x faster load step response compared to single-loop designs while maintaining the efficiency benefits of series-capacitor buck converters.
contributions: Dual-loop control (20 MHz fast + 1 MHz slow) improves transient response dynamics
Non-uniform inductor specification with specified current allocation for optimal transient distribution
Concurrent multi-inductor activation increases load step slew rate 2x vs. sequential activation
Maintains efficiency and reliability of series-capacitor buck topology

metrics.other: 2x load step slew rate improvement, fast transient response

limitations: Abstract lacks efficiency numbers, silicon area, and power loss breakdown.
primary_theme: Fast transient multi-inductor buck hybrid DC-DC
